failure_shape.name: Universal Objective -> Bounded Family Reparameterization -> No Inter-Height Generator -> Burden-Preserving Restatement
failure_shape.why_it_fails: For any candidate zero rho, choosing T=|Im(rho)|+1 makes the bounded family logically equivalent to RH. The parameter T localizes a counterexample but supplies no relation that propagates truth from one height to the next.
failure_shape.not_a_failure_of: The equivalence itself is correct. The failure is treating equivalence/localization as progress toward the missing analytic exclusion.

selected_trajectory.name: Defect-flow plus constructive positivity witness
selected_trajectory.reason: It adds a consequence-bearing state variable and a transition geometry; it does not merely restate RH at each T.
steps: Define O(T) as the multiplicity count of off-critical-line zeros in the bounded critical strip.
Prove O(T) is nonnegative, integer-valued, monotone, and locally finite.
Prove RH iff O(T)=0 for every T.
Assume O is nonzero and extract the first jump height T* and corresponding off-line orbit.
Map that orbit to a finite negative witness for an equivalent positivity functional, preferably Weil's quadratic form or Li coefficients.
Prove the same functional nonnegative from the prime/explicit-formula side, yielding contradiction.

claim_status: Research architecture only. The crucial positivity contradiction is not proved.
